product_metadata.title: Peppa Pig 3-Section Plate, Break Resistant and BPA-free plastic by Zak! Designs
features: Sometimes peas and carrots just don't go together - this divided plate keeps foods separate
Divided dinner plates keeps foods separate
description: Sometimes peas and carrots just don't go together - this divided plate keeps foods separate, with help from your favorite Disney Princesses. This durable melamine plate is 8 inches long and 8-3/4 inches wide with three sections of different sizes, perfect for a main dish, vegetables, and fruit. The character images are large and bold - kids will be eager to finish their meals and uncover Rapunzel, Cinderella, and Ariel. The rim is easy to grip for small hands, while the raised edges make sure food stays on the plate and not on the table. Can't get enough? Multiple plates nest well together for easy storage. It's the perfect addition to mealtime, snack time, or anytime. This plate is dishwasher safe for convenient cleanup and BPA free for peace of mind. Do not microwave. Recommended for children ages 3+.
